description: Catalogue of the original engine's pre-cached 3D model assets (Wavefront .obj) used to render the first world: terrain/ground tiles, vegetation, buildings, humanoids, fauna, monsters and items. Sourced from jCRPG-engine/cache/medium (also mirrored at lower/higher detail in cache/low, cache/low_png, cache/high). These are the geometry building blocks GeoTileLoader/ModelLoader/CubeInterpreter assemble into rendered scenes.
namingConvention: models_<category>_<subcategory?>_<name>.obj — category maps to a Java package/type under org.jcrpg.world or org.jcrpg.threed; 'sides_*.obj' are Side/Cube face geometry used directly by the space-grid interpreter.

webPort.approach: Convert/re-export .obj assets to glTF (or load .obj directly via three.js OBJLoader) and reference them from this catalogue by category so RenderEngine (jCRPG-engine/js/render_engine.js) can batch-load per biome/scene.
webPort.loaderNote: ModelLoader/ModelPool pooled and instanced these meshes for performance in Java; the web port should use three.js InstancedMesh for repeated props (trees, rocks, bushes).

categories.description: Terrain cube geometry: flat/steep ground tiles, cave floors/walls, rock faces used to build the voxel-like world grid.
Cube 'Side' geometry referenced directly by the space-partitioning grid (walls/ground overlays for special material types).
Billboard/impostor tree models placed by vegetation generation, varying per climate (acacia/palm/coconut = tropical-desert, pine/great_pine = continental/arctic, cherry = temperate).

Modular exterior building pieces (walls/roof/door/window/steps) plus standalone structures (hut, igloo, shrine, guard tower, shop) matching the Residence subclasses (House, Hut, Igloo, RoadShrine, GuardTowerSmall, SimpleShop, WoodenHouse, BrickHouse, SandIgloo).
Interior connector geometry (e.g. stairs) linking indoor floor levels.
World-placed container props (not inventory icons): barrels, baskets, chests, crates, and a throwing-knife ammo pickup model.
Base humanoid meshes for the player race (Human) and one non-selectable humanoid NPC race (Anatipion) plus a Yeti creature-humanoid.
Wildlife models used by the Ecology/EcologyGenerator to populate the world (huntable/ambient animals).
Hostile creature models used in encounters (J3DEncounterEngine / EncounterLogic).
